focus: Inside the city: Northeast Philadelphia (Tacony, Lawncrest, Fox Chase), Bridesburg, Port Richmond, Juniata, Logan, Roxborough, South Philadelphia near the stadiums, and Eastwick near the airport
intro: These Philadelphia listings were checked on Public Storage’s own facility pages on November 23, 2026, and cover all ten Public Storage locations the operator lists for the city of Philadelphia — mostly in the Northeast and river wards, plus Roxborough, Logan, South Philadelphia near the stadiums, and Eastwick near the airport. We copied published access hours and office hours separately, and we only flag climate control when the facility’s own page lists it (7 of the ten do). None of these facilities published around-the-clock access hours: 8 pages show a “24/7 Access Available” badge, but every access-hours table is 6:00 AM–10:00 PM daily, so we recorded the table and noted the badge. This is a starting sample from one operator, not a citywide inventory; none of the ten is in Center City, other operators such as CubeSmart and Extra Space are not included yet, and suburbs such as Upper Darby, Cherry Hill, and King of Prussia are not covered. We do not cache live unit prices or vacancy.

listings.name: Public Storage — 6301 Tacony Street
listings.area: Tacony Street, Tacony / Wissinoming near I-95 (19135)

accessHours.notes: The facility page also displays a “24/7 Access Available” badge. The published access-hours table is 6:00 AM–10:00 PM daily. Confirm access with the facility. The page’s description text separately says access is available from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, which is shorter than the table; confirm with the facility.

listings.visitNotes: The facility page does not list climate-control storage among its features and publishes “All Rentals Month to Month.” We did not treat the 24/7 badge as published around-the-clock gate hours because the access-hours table is a shorter window. The page lists a property manager living on-site. Vehicle options listed: car storage.
